issues.title: The focusable element does not have any pixel changing color when it is focused because the default styling has been overwritten by a style that removes the outline.
issues.why_it_matters_for_persona: As a keyboard-only user, I rely on a visible focus indicator to know where I am on the page. When the focus is not visible on the 'ACT rules' link, I can get lost and cannot confidently navigate or interact with the page.
remediation_instructions: Ensure that all focusable elements have a visible focus indicator.
Remove the CSS that suppresses the default focus outline (e.g., `outline: none;` or `outline: 0;`) on the anchor element.
If removing the default outline, provide a highly visible alternative focus style, such as a prominent border or background color change.
expected_tool_change: A keyboard navigation test should show a visible focus indicator on the 'ACT rules' link when it is focused.
An automated tool should detect that a focusable element is missing a visible focus style.
